resources.string: "Mongosky is a social media platform created to help people connect, communicate, share their ideas, and discover meaningful content."
"The platform brings posts, images, videos, reels, comments, reactions, connections, messaging, and intelligent assistance together in one clean and accessible experience."
"Mongosky continues to grow with a focus on simplicity, performance, privacy, safety, and respectful communication."
"Mongosky is a modern social communication platform where users can create profiles, publish content, interact with posts, watch reels, follow other users, and communicate with their community."
"The platform is designed to make sharing and communication feel simple on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices."
"Mongosky brings people and conversations together through posts, media, reactions, comments, connections, reels, and messaging."
"2. What You Can Do on Mongosky"
"Publish text, images, videos, captions, and other supported content with your community."
"React to posts, write comments, reply to discussions, and participate in meaningful conversations."
"Discover and watch short video content through the Mongosky Reels experience."
"Follow other users, view profiles, and stay connected with people and content that interest you."
"E-Text is Mongosky’s messaging feature for communication between Mongosky users."
"Access intelligent assistance and platform information through the Mongosky AI experience."
"Mongosky aims to create an online space where people can express themselves, communicate freely, discover useful content, and build genuine connections."
"The platform is being developed to remain easy to understand while supporting the performance, reliability, and security expected from a modern social media service."
"Mongosky encourages authentic expression, responsible sharing, personal privacy, respectful discussion, and the safety of every community member."
"Features should be understandable, useful, accessible, and designed around real user needs."
"Every user should be able to participate without harassment, exploitation, deception, or avoidable harm."
"Users should understand how their information is handled and have practical ways to manage their account and content."
"Mongosky supports genuine identity, meaningful expression, and responsible interaction between users."
"The platform is developed with attention to speed, responsive design, stable navigation, and dependable data delivery."
"Mongosky will continue to improve through careful development, testing, feedback, and responsible innovation."
"Mongosky was launched on 20 November 2025 with the goal of building a distinctive and dependable social media platform."
"Since its launch, Mongosky has continued to expand its social features, media experience, community tools, account services, and technical foundation."
"Mongosky uses React and TypeScript for its frontend experience, Go for its backend services, and MongoDB for its database."
"The platform architecture is being developed to support responsive interfaces, maintainable features, efficient data access, media delivery, account security, and future growth."
"Mongosky was founded by Murad Ahmed Simanto."
"A.H. Rohan, also known as Arafat Hasan Rohan, is the co-founder and works on the management of the Mongosky website."
"Mongosky is continuing to improve its website while developing smooth and consistent mobile experiences for Android and iOS."

"Mongosky’s Android and iOS applications are currently under development. The team is working on performance, navigation, media delivery, account security, notifications, privacy, and a consistent mobile experience."
"New features and improvements will be introduced carefully after development and testing so that the platform remains stable, useful, and easy to maintain."
"A strong social platform depends on both responsible technology and responsible users."

"Everyone who uses Mongosky is encouraged to respect other people, protect private information, share authentic content, follow the Community Guidelines, and report harmful activity through the available support tools."
"For questions, feedback, safety concerns, or assistance with Mongosky, use the Help and Support option available within Settings."

"I can\'t sign in. What should I do?"

"Check that you are using the email address registered with your account. If you forgot your password, use Forgot password on the sign-in page. If you still need help, contact support and select Account help."

"On the sign-in page, tap Forgot password and enter your account email. Follow the verification steps to set a new password. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive. Never share the verification code with anyone."
"Open your own Profile and tap Edit profile. Update the available details and save your changes. If a change does not appear, reopen your profile after checking your connection."
"How do I edit or delete my post?"
"Find a post you created and open its three-dot menu. Choose Edit to make changes or Delete to remove it. You can manage your own posts; another person\'s posts cannot be edited from your account."

"Check your internet connection and allow access to the photo or video you selected. Try the upload again using a supported file from your phone. If it keeps failing, select Report a problem and describe what happened and any error shown."
"How do I report harmful content or impersonation?"

"Contact support and choose Privacy & safety. Include the profile name, a post or profile link if you have one, and a clear description. You can add a screenshot in your email app before sending. Share only the information needed to explain the issue."
"How can I keep my account secure?"

"Use a strong password that you do not use on other websites. Keep your account email secure and do not share passwords or verification codes. If you suspect someone else can access your account, reset your password and contact support."
"Where can I read the privacy policy?"
"Open Settings and select Privacy Policy. For a question about your personal data or privacy, contact support and choose Privacy & safety."

"In your phone\'s Android settings, open Apps, select Mongosky, and check Notifications. Allow the notifications you want to receive. Also check Do Not Disturb, your connection, and any battery restrictions on the app."
"My feed is not showing recent updates."

"Check your internet connection, reopen the feed, and refresh it. If the issue continues, close and reopen Mongosky. Use Report a problem to tell us which screen is affected and what you expected to see."
"The app is slow or closes unexpectedly."

"Close and reopen the app and check that your phone has free storage. Install an app update if one is available. If it happens again, use Report a problem and include the steps that caused it. You can choose to include the app and Android versions."
"How can I suggest a new feature?"
"Use Send feedback below. Tell us what you would like to do and how the change would help. Your message opens in your email app, where you can review and send it to Mongosky support."

"A safer community starts with all of us"

"These guidelines explain the standards everyone must follow when using our platform. They are designed to protect freedom of expression while keeping the community safe, respectful, authentic, and welcoming."

"Pause before you post, consider how your actions may affect others, and use reporting tools when something does not feel safe. Respectful participation from every member makes the entire community stronger."
"Our platform brings people together to share ideas, experiences, creativity, and meaningful conversations."
"These guidelines apply to everyone and to all parts of the platform, including profiles, posts, comments, messages, images, videos, reels, links, usernames, and other shared content."

"We understand that context matters. When reviewing content, we may consider its purpose, language, cultural context, potential harm, public interest, and whether it was shared for awareness, education, documentation, or criticism."

"Using this platform means agreeing to follow these standards. Content or behaviour that violates them may be removed or restricted, and accounts may face further action depending on the seriousness or frequency of the violation."
"Communicate with empathy, respect personal boundaries, and never use the platform to intimidate, exploit, or harm another person."
"Different opinions are welcome, but attacks against people are not. Disagreement should focus on ideas and actions rather than humiliation or personal abuse."
"Do not repeatedly insult, shame, threaten, mock, intimidate, or target another person. Encouraging others to participate in harassment is also prohibited."

"Do not attack, degrade, exclude, or promote hatred against people based on race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, disability, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, caste, or another protected characteristic."
"Do not describe individuals or groups as less than human, inherently dangerous, diseased, or deserving of violence or exclusion."
"Sexual harassment, unwanted sexual comments, coercion, exploitation, and repeated sexual advances are not allowed."
"The platform must not be used to direct harassment or coordinated attacks toward another person or community."
"Do not publish content with the purpose of sending abusive attention, threats, or humiliation toward a person."
"Do not share private or sensitive material to punish, shame, blackmail, or control someone."
"Do not knowingly publish fabricated allegations that could seriously damage another person\'s safety or reputation."
"Content that creates a credible risk of physical harm may be removed immediately and, when necessary, referred to an appropriate authority."
"Do not make credible threats, celebrate serious violence, request violent acts, or encourage others to physically harm a person or group."
"Support, recruitment, praise, or operational assistance for terrorist, extremist, organised criminal, or violent groups is prohibited."
"Do not encourage challenges, instructions, or behaviour that could foreseeably cause serious injury, poisoning, or death."
"Do not encourage, glorify, or provide instructions for suicide or self-harm. Supportive discussion, recovery stories, and help-seeking information are allowed."
"If you believe someone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services instead of relying only on an in-platform report."
"Children and young people require greater protection"
"We apply strict standards to content or behaviour that could exploit, endanger, sexualise, manipulate, or inappropriately contact a minor."
"Any content, request, conversation, or behaviour involving the sexual exploitation or abuse of a minor is strictly prohibited."
"Adults must not build relationships with minors for sexual, exploitative, manipulative, or otherwise harmful purposes."
"Do not reveal a minor\'s private location, school, contact details, routine, or other information that could place them at risk."
"Authentic participation helps people understand who and what they can trust. Never mislead others for influence, money, or artificial engagement."
"You may use a preferred name, creative identity, parody, or fan account, but you must not intentionally deceive others about who you are."
"Do not pretend to be another person, organisation, public figure, or authorised representative in a way that is likely to mislead people."
"Do not create accounts to hide coordinated abuse, avoid enforcement, manipulate conversations, or conduct fraudulent activity."
"Do not buy, sell, automate, or exchange followers, reactions, comments, views, or other engagement in a misleading way."
"Clearly disclose paid promotions, sponsorships, affiliate relationships, and other material connections where appropriate."
"People should be able to make decisions without being deliberately manipulated by false, fabricated, or materially altered information."
"Do not knowingly spread false information that is likely to cause serious physical, financial, civic, or public harm."
"Do not use edited, synthetic, or AI-generated media to deceive people about important events or make someone appear to say or do something they did not."
"Do not present old, unrelated, or selectively edited material as evidence of a current event when doing so could seriously mislead people."
"When possible, correct significant errors clearly. Satire, parody, opinion, and good-faith mistakes may be treated differently when their context is apparent."
"Keep the community free from spam and scams"
"Do not use the platform to manipulate users, distribute harmful material, or obtain money, accounts, or personal information through deception."
"Fake investments, fraudulent sales, advance-fee schemes, impersonation scams, and deceptive fundraising are prohibited."
"Do not request passwords or verification codes, distribute malware, or direct users to deceptive websites designed to steal information."
"Do not repeatedly publish unwanted promotions, duplicate comments, irrelevant links, or mass messages that disrupt normal use."
"Giveaways, job offers, discounts, and competitions must not use false claims, hidden charges, or misleading participation requirements."
"Share only content you created or have permission and a lawful basis to use."
"Do not upload or redistribute protected images, music, videos, writing, software, or other work without permission or a valid legal exception."
"Do not misuse names, logos, or brand identities in a way that causes confusion about source, ownership, or endorsement."
